reviewer: Claude source, predicate and witness review
scope: robocasa PickPlaceCounterToCabinet at the pinned revision; seed 0 witness only. Semantic projection of the official predicate, not physical qualification of other seeds or scenes.
task_language: Pick the measuring cup from the counter and place it in the cabinet. (Object category sampled per seed.)

predicate_and_helpers.basis: Read _check_success, obj_inside_of (bounding-box corners against fixture int sites) and gripper_obj_far (eef site distance).

reset_and_randomization.basis: Read _setup_kitchen_references/_get_obj_cfgs: cabinet and counter sampled per seed; target object on the counter in front of the cabinet, one distractor on the counter and one in the back of the cabinet.

assets_and_frames.basis: Interior regions come from the cabinet's int sites in world frame; the object bounding box uses its MJCF extents at its current pose.

success_timing.basis: Evaluated after every control step; the ORA session latches the first success.

public_observability.basis: Object, cabinet and gripper are visible in the agentview/wrist cameras; withdrawal distance is judged from measured gripper pose and the cameras.

success_witness.basis: Witness: object placed on the floor of the cabinet interior with the robot at its start pose (gripper 0.88 m away) gives true.

counterexamples.basis: Witness: partly outside, at the gripper, and the reset state give false.

no_expert_strategy.basis: Clauses state end conditions only; no approach, grasp, route or motion advice.

privacy.basis: No coordinates, thresholds, fixture or object identifiers, joint values or predicate names enter the public text; numeric limits stay in this private record.

conditions.source_basis: OU.obj_inside_of(env, 'obj', cab): all eight bounding-box corners of the object inside one cabinet interior region (5 cm slack).
conditions.interpretation: The whole object must be inside the cabinet interior.

conditions.source_basis: OU.gripper_obj_far(env): right end-effector site more than 0.25 m from the object body origin.
conditions.interpretation: Release the object and withdraw the gripper well away.
The 0.25 m withdrawal distance and the 5 cm interior slack are withheld.
conditions.omission_reason: Numeric limits stay qualitative; the distractor already in the cabinet is irrelevant to the predicate.

public_clauses: Place the object so that the whole of it sits inside the cabinet, not on the cabinet's edge or partly outside it.
Then let go of it and move the gripper well away from it; the task is not complete while the gripper stays close to the object.

counterexamples.case: Object shifted half out of the cabinet opening: false.
Object held at the gripper outside the cabinet: false.
Object inside the cabinet with the gripper still beside it: false by gripper_obj_far (source-derived, not executed).

limitations: Witness covers seed 0 only and uses direct state edits or scripted moves, never a policy rollout; source-derived negative cases marked as such were not executed.
